text:
alex: quick heads-up — bringing up a new candidate for onboarding: skyline-13b-prime (checkpoint v2). want to capture perf intake and prioritize warmup/quant checks

mira: sweet. primary goals: baseline throughput, ctx sweep (2k/4k/8k), int8 vs fp16 latency, and quality smoke tests against our chat evals. also cold start priming impact.

ryan: added to triage board. initial ask: run a quick micro-bench for batch sizes [1,4,8,16] at seq=2048, quant=int8 and fp16 so we have rough perf numbers. can someone run benchbot?

benchbot: queued: rbench --model skyline-13b-prime --seq 2048 --batches 1,4,8,16 --quant int8,fp16 --warmup 10 --runs 50. estimate ~45m on a single p4d shard. will post summary when done. :hourglass_flowing_sand:

alex: thanks benchbot. also important: test prefix/KV caching effects — shortcut is run with priming prompt of 128 tokens then measure streaming latency for subsequent tokens.

mira: noted. i'll prep the priming prompt and the QA set for quality regression (50 hard prompts from chat-evals). flagging threshold: if int8 median token latency > fp16 median token latency * 1.25 or throughput delta > 30% we escalate.

ryan: for cold-start experiments, we should compare cold-first-token latency after process spinup vs warmed KV-cache case. I'll run:
```
# cold start
rstart --model skyline-13b-prime --quant int8 --mem-profile
rbench --seq 2048 --batch 1 --warmup 0 --runs 20
\n# warmed
rbench --seq 2048 --batch 1 --warmup 20 --runs 50
```
\nryan: will capture p95/p99 and token throughput. posting baseline numbers in ~1h.

benchbot: micro-bench complete: summary:
- fp16 batch1: 22 req/s, median token latency 45ms
- fp16 batch8: 160 req/s, median token latency 38ms (amortized)
- int8 batch1: 28 req/s, median token latency 38ms
- int8 batch8: 280 req/s, median token latency 31ms
notes: int8 shows better throughput and slightly lower median latency for steady-state; tail latencies similar.

sophia: interesting — int8 better here. we should still run quality smoke asap. i've kicked off chat-evals/skyline-prime-int8 vs fp16 with the 50-case set. will post delta in model-evals slack when done.

mira: checklist for bring-up (action items):
- owner: alex (overall)
- perf lead: ryan (bench suite + coldstart)
- quality lead: sophia (evals + compare to baseline model)
- infra: ops-bot (capacity + canary routing)
- tasks:
  1) full ctx sweep: seq 2048/4096/8192, batch heuristics for each
  2) quant matrix: int8-ntk4, int8-ntk2, fp16, int4 (if supported)
  3) warmup priming impact test (128 token prefix)
  4) KV cache memory profile and hot-restart behavior
  5) quality regressions on chat-evals, hallucination checklists
  6) integration smoke: streaming + tool-calls in canary

alex: + add rollout gating: automatic fallback to fp16 if regressions exceed 3% on critical metrics, and capacity fallback if throughput below 60% of expected for two consecutive 10m windows.

ops-bot: assigned infra tickets: INF-4821 (reserve 2 p4d shards for canary), INF-4822 (enable priming cache warmup hook), ETA 2d.

ryan: quick note on benchmarking methodology: make sure to pin CPU affinity and disable noisy collectors. use `rbench --cpu-pin --no-collector` for consistent tails. also log GPU SM utilization.

mira: timeline proposal: 24h micro-bench + quality smoke, 48-72h full ctx/quant matrix. prioritize warmup/priming and coldstart tails in first wave.

alex: sounds good. leaving checklist in this thread as the canonical intake. tagging people: @mira @ryan @sophia for visibility. will follow-up with canary config once infra tickets land. :rocket:

sophia: quick follow-up — if int8 quality delta > 1% on rouge/accuracy we should run post-quant fine-tune or reject quant for skyline. logging that as a policy item.

benchbot: next posts: detailed CSV of micro-bench and a perf heatmap png.

alex: thanks everyone — keeping this open until canary and first 24h results.
